state.rationale: CCO unconditional provision eliminates survival-based employment coercion. Modeling shows 75%+ report genuine autonomy. PTF housing removes landlord coercion.

clause1.instructions: The clause under test is: "≥70% report genuine autonomy in major life decisions". Judge only what the text in the state itself says. Do not use outside knowledge about the economic system it describes.

criteria.asserted_met: The text states that at least 70% of people report, or would report, genuine autonomy in major life decisions.
criteria.asserted_short: The text states a share below 70%, or states that people's major life decisions remain compelled by survival or market pressure.
criteria.not_asserted: The text states no share of people reporting genuine autonomy in major life decisions, and does not say the share is below 70%.

clause2.instructions: The clause under test is: "validated through revealed preference showing acceptance of initially refused employment/living situations when alternatives exist". Revealed preference here means observed behaviour of real people living under the system (for example more selective job changes, moving home by preference, staying in education without income pressure, starting businesses) that confirms what they report. Judge only what the text in the state itself says. Do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.shown: The text cites observed behaviour of real people living under the system that confirms their reported autonomy.
criteria.not_shown: The text cites no observed behaviour of real people under the system; it describes mechanisms, design features, models, surveys of self-reports, or claims only.

clause2.instructions: The clause under test is: "validated through revealed preference showing acceptance of initially refused employment/living situations when alternatives exist". Revealed preference here means observed behaviour of real people living under the system (for example more selective job changes, moving home by preference, staying in education without income pressure, starting businesses) that confirms what they report. Judge only what the text in the state itself says. Do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.shown: The text cites observed behaviour of real people living under the system that confirms their reported autonomy.
criteria.not_shown: The text cites no observed behaviour of real people under the system; it describes mechanisms, design features, models, surveys of self-reports, or claims only.

clause2.instructions: The clause under test is: "removal/replacement mechanisms functional". It is met when the text describes a mechanism by which the people subject to an authority can remove or replace the people who hold that authority: recall, elections at fixed terms, term limits, rotation, or selection by lot for limited terms; or, where no authority is delegated to office-holders, a way for the people bound by decisions to revoke or reopen those decisions. A stated commitment to democracy, accountability, decentralisation or distributed power is a goal, not a mechanism, and does not meet the clause. Judge only what the text in the state says.

criteria.shown: The text describes such a mechanism.
criteria.not_shown: The text describes no such mechanism; it states goals, values, structures or outcomes only.
